# What does one home inspection really earn per hour, and would an associate add profit?

> Free home inspector calculator: enter inspections per week, fees by size, add-ons, on-site, report and drive hours, mileage, fall-through, E&O and software, and see profit per inspection and per hour, the fee for your target margin, break-even inspections per month and whether to hire an associate.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
